title: Troubleshooting Streaming Quality Issues
content: If you're experiencing streaming quality issues: 1) Check your internet speed — we recommend at least 5 Mbps for HD and 25 Mbps for 4K. 2) Restart your router and device. 3) Close other bandwidth-heavy apps. 4) In the player, go to Settings > Quality and try a lower setting. 5) Clear your browser cache or reinstall the app. If issues persist, contact support with your device type and error message.
